text:
alex_sales: FYI prospect LedgerWave sent security checklist. Requirements: dual HSM (us-east/us-west), weekly rotation at 22:00 PST, no-unwrapped-keys anywhere, and they asked: do you support Shamir secret splitting?
pat_se: We support customer-managed keys via HSM proxy. We accept wrapped key blobs and can perform signing against provided key handles. We DO NOT perform Shamir splitting on our side  that must be done client-side or by a partner in their network.
pat_se: quick config example for POC:
```
proxy_mode: sidecar
hsm_targets: [hsm-east:1234, hsm-west:1234]
wrap_validation: strict
```
mina_security: Security notes: require HSM vendor attestation (FIPS/L3?) and module IDs. If retention >12 months we need legal/SOC2 addendum. Also confirm that logs never contain unwrapped key material; only digests allowed.
nate_sre: Perf: expect ~7-12ms added for cross-region HSM calls; sync dual-sign will hurt p99. For POC we recommend a mock HSM to measure baseline then run scaled tests. Onboarding checklist: 1) allowlist IPs 198.51.100.20 2) upload certs 3) provide wrapped blobs 4) run rotation dry-run at 22:00 PST
deploy-bot: deploy: byo-hsm-proxy v1.9 started -> https://ci.redwood/build/2789
alex_sales: Customer insists "vendor-side Shamir" is mandatory. Can we offer a partner-run split?
pat_se: We can document partner integration: partner performs split in customer's network and hands overlapped wrapped artifacts to us. Include as an integration line in SOW and mark as customer responsibility for key-material security.
mina_security: I'll compile required vendor cert list and vetted Shamir client libraries to include in the pack.
pat_se: I'll draft a 2-week POC SOW: acceptance = dual-sign failover, rotation dry-run, no-plaintext in logs. Pricing: reserved proxy + per-1M sign tiers + optional chaos/failover test as add-on.
alex_sales: Great. I'll update RFQ and attach SOW when ready. Thanks!
